mapper.select: select rr.id, rr.review_id, rr.reader_id, rr.reply_content, rr.created_at, rr.updated_at, rr.deleted, u.username as reader_username from review_replies rr join users u on rr.reader_id = u.id where rr.review_id = #{reviewId} and rr.deleted = false order by rr.created_at asc

select rr.id, rr.review_id, rr.reader_id, rr.reply_content, rr.created_at, rr.updated_at, rr.deleted, u.username as reader_username from review_replies rr join users u on rr.reader_id = u.id where rr.id = #{id} and rr.deleted = false
mapper.insert: insert into review_replies(review_id, reader_id, reply_content, created_at, updated_at, deleted) values(#{review.id}, #{reader.id}, #{replyContent}, now(), now(), false)
mapper.update: update review_replies set reply_content = #{replyContent}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
update review_replies set deleted = true, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
